---
applyTo: 'packages/{pixels,uniform,megapixels,atelier}/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'
---

For component changes, review public props and inferred types, semantic HTML,
accessible names, focus and keyboard behavior, controlled state, loading and
error states, and reduced-motion behavior. Require focused unit coverage and a
Storybook story for each meaningful new state. Visual evidence supplements but
does not replace deterministic tests.
